semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Losses are defined on W, predictions belong to W, and fixed comparators belong to V⊆W. Lean uses X=Subtype W and comparator set {w:Subtype W | w.val∈V}; inclusion embeds a subtype-V comparator without changing its value. The source uses finite-dimensional Euclidean vectors; the shared algebraic API explicitly generalizes the carrier. Footnote1 states a modelling possibility, not a generic algorithm or performance theorem. NoRegret means, for each fixed feasible comparator u and every positive epsilon, normalized regret is eventually at most epsilon. The threshold may depend on u and epsilon. This is an explicit interpretation of the source displayed ordinary-limit inequality: it agrees when the ordinary limit exists, but proves no ordinary limit existence, convergence tozero, absolute bound, nonnegative regret or uniform comparator threshold.
